title: shawk / Dependency map (live)
description: Live 1-hop service dependency map from Prometheus, for deployments without PostgreSQL.

list.name: service
list.label: Service

query.query: query_result(count by (service) (label_replace(count by (src) ({__name__=~"shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m|shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m|shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m|shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m"}), "service", "$1", "src", "(.*)")) or count by (service) (label_replace(count by (dst) ({__name__=~"shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m|shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m|shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m|shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m"}), "service", "$1", "dst", "(.*)")))

list.definition: query_result(count by (service) (label_replace(count by (src) ({__name__=~"shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m|shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m|shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m|shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m"}), "service", "$1", "src", "(.*)")) or count by (service) (label_replace(count by (dst) ({__name__=~"shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m|shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m|shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m|shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m"}), "service", "$1", "dst", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Live dependencies of $service (1-hop)

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (id) (label_replace(sum by (src) (shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} or (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0)), "id", "$1", "src", "(.*)") or label_replace(sum by (dst) (shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} or (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0)), "id", "$1", "dst", "(.*)")), "title", "$1", "id", "(.*)")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(sum by (src, dst) (shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} or (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_request_datagrams:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m{src=~"$service"} * 0) or (shawk:dependency_response_datagrams:rate5m{dst=~"$service"} * 0)), "id", "__", "src", "dst"), "id", "${1}_${2}", "id", "(.*?)[^A-Za-z0-9_.:/~-]+(.*)"), "id", "${1}_${2}", "id", "(.*?)[^A-Za-z0-9_.:/~-]+(.*)"), "id", "${1}_${2}", "id", "(.*?)[^A-Za-z0-9_.:/~-]+(.*)"), "source", "$1", "src", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "dst", "(.*)")

panels.description: 1-hop dependencies active in Prometheus around the selected services (edge mainstat is connections/s; node mainstat is peak outgoing or incoming connections/s; failure-only and UDP edges are included at 0 conn/s). Use PostgreSQL mode (shawk-map) for multi-hop walks and long-term history.

targets.expr: sum by (src, dst, server_port, network_transport) (shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_connections:rate5m{dst=~"$service"})
sum by (src, dst, server_port, network_transport) (shawk:dependency_request_bytes:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_request_bytes:rate5m{dst=~"$service"})
sum by (src, dst, server_port, network_transport) (shawk:dependency_response_bytes:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_response_bytes:rate5m{dst=~"$service"})
sum by (src, dst, server_port, network_transport) (shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{src=~"$service"} or shawk:dependency_connection_failures:rate5m{dst=~"$service"})
